description:
Hey guys! We are interested in space exploration, Earth systems, planets, and using creativity and technology to solve real-world challenges. Our goal is to develop an innovative idea for the challenge by exploring data, identifying patterns, and presenting our findings in an understandable way. 

We welcome team members who are interested. You don’t need to be an expert — curiosity, motivation, and teamwork are what matter most!

Let’s work together, share ideas, and build something amazing.
